# v1.21.1b1 — Automatic default dashboard updates

- Keep the integration-owned AlphaESS dashboard up to date after manual edits.
  On setup and entity/device registry changes, Main, Readings and Diagnostics
  refresh to the current default, including newly enabled sensors.
- Back up the previous layout before replacement. Keep permanent customisations
  in a separate dashboard copy; separate copies and YAML dashboards are untouched.
- Correct grid-current descriptions: values may be signed, and the sign
  convention depends on the inverter/meter. Readings are preserved as reported.

This is a beta for testing dashboard refreshes. Inverter controls, register
addresses, scaling and polling are unchanged.

Enable beta versions for this repository in HACS, select **v1.21.1b1**, restart
Home Assistant and refresh the frontend. The default dashboard layout will be
refreshed, including previously edited layouts. Copy any layout to keep into a
separate dashboard before updating.

The original migration backup is retained, alongside a backup of the immediately
previous layout. A failed backup prevents replacement. See the
[dashboard guide](https://github.com/PlainSeer/ha-alphaess-modbus-tcp/blob/v1.21.1b1/docs/saved-dashboard.md)
for details.

To leave the beta, select **v1.21.0** in HACS and restart Home Assistant. Selecting
the older version alone does not restore a previous dashboard layout.
